backend.deviceOwnership: Application requests adapter and GPUDevice, then supplies that exact device to WebGPURenderer; backend and device identity asserted after initialization

source.identity: city.json sourceHash, plus validation SHA-256 of served files
source.attributes: Uncompressed Float32 positions and split normals, Uint32 triangle indices; exact source instance matrices

batching.method: One BatchedMesh per semantic material, splitting water by exact plane height, with original per-prototype geometry and exact Float32 instance matrices
batching.culling: Three BatchedMesh perObjectFrustumCulled, evaluated separately for each beauty, reflection and shadow camera
batching.sourceMatrices: Float32 RGBA matrix textures owned by BatchedMesh; every original instance and per-part semantic ID retained

quality.depth: Logarithmic depth buffer for centimetre-scale terrain overlays across the 2.18km city

passes.geometry: All exact visible source geometry except non-occluding water
passes.cache: Static source and sun; invalidated on switching overview/walking or moving walking shadow region by 32 metres

passes.ownership: TSL ReflectorNode camera-correct scene reflections in water material; one capture per exact world-space water height; no additional environment specular on water
passes.geometry: Full scene and offscreen contributors; reflection recursion disabled
passes.cache: No camera-dependent reflection reuse across rendered frames

passes.ownership: Single WebGPURenderer render of the complete scene; PBR opaque and static Fresnel water

environment.method: Procedural sky gradient, RGBA Float32 512x256, PMREM

lighting.AO: Not implemented; contact is represented by directional shadows

effects.water: Static Fresnel blend of source water color and full-resolution planar scene reflection; opaque water, no volumetric transmission
effects.surfaces: Small static world-space TSL noise modulation on grass, paving, stone and asphalt; original material colors and geometry retained
effects.foliage: Source geometry and split normals; opaque, static, no wind
effects.atmosphere: Light distance fog beginning at3400 metres, beyond the top-down camera height, ending at9000 metres

time.renderPolicy: Render on camera/controller/viewport changes and explicit profiling; static idle views reuse the completed frame

navigation.collision: Spatially indexed oriented source footprint rectangles; trees use trunk footprints; water polygons with island exclusions; explicit support surfaces for bridges/docks
navigation.regionalInspection: Lake and park aerial poses fit the current manifest water/path extents; walking spawns stay from the source manifest with collision-safe adjustment, and the lake spawn faces along the nearby promenade tangent
navigation.sourceComparisonCameras: Diagnostic captures use source camera poses and the Blender horizontal lens model: 36mm sensor, 26mm non-overview focal length. Normal walking stays48 degrees vertical.

validation: runtime_validation.json records actual results; render choices do not imply that tests passed
compatibilityGuard: Three r186 ReflectorNode recursive renders are suppressed only during compileAsync; actual reflection frames use the original updateBefore implementation. Shadow render target explicitly initialized before first frame.
